Episode 237. Even If The Sun Disappears, The Light Remains

A month had passed since the end of the Zito subjugation war. The Bammel Alliance was recognized for the most significant contributions among all forces that participated in the subjugation war by the saints.
From the perspective of the people of Hufester, it was a perfect victory. In Hufester, festivals celebrating the eradication of demons were held daily.

However, those who had been fighting the demons on the front lines could not laugh. Behind the victory, there were countless sorrows and pains of those who were brainwashed and used that the general public could not know.
There was also the destruction of a once peaceful world.
The fire of destruction left by Kelliac was still eroding the underworld, even more than a month after the end of the war.
"You're here."
Kingdom of Mila, tent.
Jin waved his hand to the demons who had just arrived. They were wearing black robes that did not fit the festival.
"It seems we're late."
"I'm sorry. Did we keep you waiting, Jin Runcandel?"
"No, don't worry about it. I just arrived myself."
It was Tilius and Misol.

Thanks to Murakan, they were able to survive from the fire of destruction. At the time, Misol was not in the Poison Castle where the fire of destruction began, but eventually, the fire spread throughout the underworld, so Misol was also a lucky survivor.
"It's been two weeks. We were almost always together when we were restoring the underworld."
"Yes... Thanks to you, we demons were able to avoid extinction."
At those words, Jin felt sorry.
If it wasn't for his regression, would the underworld have suffered this tragedy? It was not easy to shake off such thoughts.
It was a concern that always troubled Jin when he, as a regressor, changed many histories of the world, but this time was different. The population of a world had decreased by over 90%.
"Jin always looks bad when he hears this. Don't be like that. If it wasn't for you, we would all be dead. Either killed by Zito or Kelliac."
"......If Basset hadn't sacrificed himself back then, Misol might not be here now."
Basset Biseps.

Before the Fire of Destruction began, he had sought the Poison Castle with Tilius. And just before the Fire of Destruction reached its peak, he manifested all of his 'Authority of Blockage' to scatter the flames temporarily.
It was a miracle. Basset was weakened and worn out due to Ridolros.
Now, about 1.5 million demons have survived in the Underworld. It's not a small number, but considering the original population that reached hundreds of billions, it had to be small.
Among them, 900,000 were refugees from Biseps, the rest were survivors of the flames being rescued by Biseps.
"And if Silkia Arcia wasn't there, most of the people left in the Biseps' refuge now would probably have died."
-Silkia.
-Yes, Lord Basset.
-From now on, you are the head of Biseps. Take good care of those left. Remember that you are an entity that can become a god.
The last words Basset left to Silkia.
Jin relayed this story to Tilius and Misol. As Basset said, Silkia was indeed an entity that could become a god.

No, her 'dimensional travel' ability was already godlike. At the time when the Fire of Destruction spread, the survival of the members of Biseps was entirely due to her dimensional gate. She opened a dimensional gate that could move nearly a million people.
That dimensional gate instantly moved the Biseps members to the last refuge of Biseps at the end of the Underworld. Valeria doubted her eyes the moment she confirmed that record.
"So all I've done is wage war in the Underworld. There's no need to feel grateful to me."
"The fact that you killed Zito is true, Jin."
"Yes. Killing him was almost like there's another real villain out there."
Kelliac Zifl.

Jin's pupils narrowed as he recalled the recent moves of him and Elona. They seized control of Zifl in no time after that day, and now the Lutero Federation has become more dangerous and bleak than ever.

"Besides, you tried to save Hell, which had nothing to do with you until then, even with your nemesis right in front of you. My brother's sacrifice and Silkia's ability were great, but if you hadn't helped the Underworld. We would still be living in the dark, not even knowing what we are......"
Most of the Biseps members were not brainwashed in the first place.
But the other survivors were different. They were brainwashed, and they were in despair about killing their families, friends, and lovers with their own hands.

Moreover, since the artificial sun disappeared, the Underworld had to become a land of darkness without a single light even after driving out Zito. It was impossible for survivors to find hope in that.
Everyone thought so.

"Survivors who were not from Bisection tried incessantly to give up on life. I think I would have been the same. I destroyed everything precious with my own hands because of Jito, what would I do living? But the light, the light you left... it keeps them alive."
Ridolros foresaw that the demon world would be plunged into darkness if the artificial sun disappeared.

The members of Bisection thought the same. They just thought it was more important to drive out Jito, even if they lost the light. Unlike Ridolros, Bisection thought they could somehow support each other and live even in the dark.
But there was an unexpected factor.
The power of rebirth that Jin had was blooming like flowers, like a swarm of fireflies, lighting up the path everywhere in the demon world.
The artificial sun disappeared, but the golden light rising from the ground was actually making the demon world brighter than before.
The demons who lost the will to live in pain and sorrow felt a strong hope when facing that light.
The innocents who died seem to be surrounded by the certainty that they will return someday following that light.
The survivors didn't let go of life as they watched that light, and they went searching for survivors following that light. It was a phenomenon that Jin himself couldn't explain.
"That's right, that's right. You've seen it, the demon world is actually more beautiful than before. When the fire of destruction disappears, it will be a shining land, even more than the ground."
Misore handed a glass of liquor to Jin. Tillyas also raised his glass.
Jin stared at them and accepted the toast.
"I hope you're not worrying about not revealing to people that all the demons had been brainwashed? Don't do that, Jin. After all, we asked for it in the first place."
As Tillyas said, the Bamel Federation did not fully disclose 'brainwashing' to the public at the request of Bisection.
Although some content has been disclosed, the fact that all the demons were innocent victims is a difficult issue for ordinary people to accept.
Just as the demons need hope, so do the people of the world. In the ongoing war that started from the Gyeomhwa Cathedral, ordinary people clearly needed their own victories.
The current Jito subjugation commemorative festival being held everywhere in Hyupest is not just joy.

The festival was also a counter-evidence to the fear of another war that was about to begin. The unilateral civil war in the Rutero Federation, which began with the return of Kellyak, was pressuring the entire world.

Bisection read the situation of the world accurately and asked the Bamel Federation to reveal the truth about the demons later. Although it was because of brainwashing, it was a clear fact that the demons invaded the world.
"I understand, Tillyas. But when true peace comes to the world someday, I will definitely fully disclose the demons' internal situation."

"I knew you were conscious of it. When I first came to find you and propose an alliance, I never imagined you had such a soft side. We kept considering the case where we were only used and then discarded, it's embarrassing."
"So we ended up not revealing the artificial sun card until the very end. It's embarrassing in hindsight."
"We didn't know each other well at the time, so it's understandable. Don't hold on to such things."
"I appreciate you saying that."
Tillias refilled the empty glasses.

They had gathered in the tent today to modestly celebrate the liberation of the demonic realm, even if it was just the three of them. Occasionally, Tillias and Misol would fill extra glasses in remembrance of Basset and their deceased comrades and then drain them on their behalf.
"Jin, you'll be fighting Kelliac Jiple now."
Jin nodded.

Kelliac, having taken over Jiple, had not shown any particular movements yet. Jin was currently focusing on the recovery of his allies and the damage in the demonic realm while keeping an eye on Kelliac's actions.
"I've heard that you have many more enemies. The Imperial Palace, the Jekmyung Tribe, the Sun Church, Kinzelo... and Ganesto. Silkia said she should help you when you fight with them."
"Silkia?"

"Yes. And all the members, including me, agreed to that. Of course, we don't have many combatants left compared to the humans, and even they are all working on restoring the damages in the demonic realm, so we can't provide military support."
"But Silkia has her abilities. She needs to recover after using a large amount of power at once, but Silkia's power will definitely be a big help to you."

"For instance, in the event of an unexpected large-scale battle, she could evacuate innocent people from the scene... She could help in that way. Conversely, Silkia could also play a role when there is a need to deploy a large number of troops to enemy lines."

"Silkia has more abilities, too. Basset once said that even she hasn't fully awakened to her power yet. So, after some time passes, contact us anytime you need her power. Or maybe Silkia will contact you first?"
The liquor bottle was being emptied.
Jin nodded. Indeed, with Silkia's abilities, they would be able to prevent as many innocent deaths as possible.
Even with the power of rebirth, that was still the most important issue to Jin. Even if the light of rebirth could one day truly revive them, as the demons believed and as Ayura said.
"Let's make a final toast."
"We need to gather our necessary supplies and head back, too."
Tillias poured out the remaining liquor.
"For a bright future."
"For a bright future."
"For a bright future."
Their glasses clinked together. The land of the demonic realm, reflected in the glasses, shimmered in gold.
